description: Pay-per-call payment channels for AI agents on devnet (Anchor 1.0.2): a provider registry metered by a gateway, and a token escrow where an agent opens a channel, signs off-chain ed25519 vouchers, and the gateway settles the latest voucher on chain. All registry and escrow instructions verified with lab tokens.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Raakshass/agentpay. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentpay-conduit. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (payment channels, voucher verification, registry)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentpay-conduit/
QA: devnet proof of voucher settlement
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Allow partial settlements without closing the channel
